description: Mengubah QRIS STATIS menjadi DINAMIS dengan nominal Rupiah. Turns a valid STATIC QRIS into a DYNAMIC one with a fixed amount in whole Rupiah: sets tag 01 to 12, inserts tag 54, optionally adds a tip/fee (tags 55-57, off by default) and recomputes the CRC. Refuses invalid or already-dynamic input. This only rewrites text: it does not move money, and the result is only as valid as the merchant's static code.

allow_dynamic_input.description: Allow a QRIS that is already dynamic (its amount is replaced). Off by default because dynamic codes are usually single-use.

amount.description: Amount in whole Rupiah, e.g. 15000 or "15.000". Max 13 digits.

qris.description: The merchant's own STATIC QRIS payload text.

tip.description: Tip/convenience fee: none (default), prompt (payer types a tip, 55=01), fixed (55=02 + 56), percent (55=03 + 57).

tip_value.description: For tip=fixed: whole Rupiah. For tip=percent: 0.01-99.99.

name: set_qris_amount
title: QRIS statis jadi dinamis / Set QRIS amount
